sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Park Safe are straightforward yet challenging. The game features a single-player mode where you must park a car in a tight space at the perfect moment, all while avoiding collisions with other cars. The car moves automatically, and your task is to use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to park it at the right time.

To succeed in Park Safe, you'll need to develop a keen sense of timing and spatial awareness. The game requires you to anticipate the car's movement and position it in the correct spot just as it reaches the parking space. This can be tricky, especially as the game speeds up and the obstacles become more challenging.

One of the key aspects of Park Safe's gameplay is its use of obstacles and challenges. The game features a variety of obstacles, including other cars, traffic cones, and even pedestrians. These obstacles can be unpredictable and will often require you to think on your feet and react quickly to succeed.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Park Safe are engaging, challenging, and fun. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, this game is sure to appeal to fans of arcade games and anyone looking for a fun challenge.
